# The MCU, In Order

> A guide to watching the Marvel Cinematic Universe: every film and series in
> release order or story order, a map of how the universes connect, and a map of
> how the characters connect. Written and maintained by one person; all
> descriptions are original.

Site: https://mcu-breakdown.vercel.app/

## What is on the page

- **Watch order** — 77 titles (films, Disney+ series, specials, and Fox's X-Men
  films) in release order or in-universe story order. Each carries its release
  date, the year it is set, runtime, why it matters, and what to watch first.
  Three paths: Speedrun (22 titles, ~58 hours), The Good Stuff (48, ~132 hours)
  and All In (74, ~211 hours). Progress is stored in the browser and can be
  carried between devices with a short code in the URL.
- **Who's who** — 141 characters with their real names, the actors who play
  them, where they first appear, every title they turn up in, and spoiler notes
  hidden behind a switch.
- **How it connects** — a map of five universes (the MCU, Fox's X-Men, the
  earlier Spider-Man films, Earth-838 and the Fantastic Four's Earth-828) and
  every title that bridges them; a map of 223 relationships between characters;
  and nine storylines that each run straight through the franchise.

## Pages

- [What to watch before Avengers: Doomsday](https://mcu-breakdown.vercel.app/what-to-watch-before-doomsday.html) — the four titles that set it up, about eleven hours.
- [Where the X-Men fit into the MCU](https://mcu-breakdown.vercel.app/x-men-in-the-mcu.html) — every mutant nod, and which Fox films matter.
- [Which Marvel Disney+ shows actually matter](https://mcu-breakdown.vercel.app/marvel-shows-that-matter.html) — required against skippable.

## Facts worth quoting

- Release order is the recommended first run; story order suits a rewatch.
- Fox's X-Men films were a separate universe until *Deadpool & Wolverine*, where
  the TVA pulls Deadpool and Logan into the MCU.
- *Avengers: Doomsday* (18 December 2026) brings back the original X-Men cast
  alongside the Avengers and the Fantastic Four.
- Marvel's official timeline puts *Iron Man* in 2010, not 2008.

## Notes

- Unofficial fan guide. Not affiliated with Marvel, Marvel Studios or Disney.
- In-universe dates are confirmed only to roughly *Avengers: Endgame*; later
  ones are reconstructed from on-screen evidence and may be wrong.
